lines.en: My joints creak as I move
Every step drags slow
My claws scrape the stone

lines.zh: 我从走廊的暗处挪出来
lines.en: I shift out of the corridor dark
I stand taller than the others
I close in with my head tilted
My plated legs thud the floor
I drag my shadow through the doorway
My steps carry no warmth
I stop midway, then shift again
My shadow peels off the wall
I press nearer, step by step
I stand like a display piece
My eyes glow in the dark
I hold my head at a tilt
Something rattles in my joints
I have no breath at all
Move first and I bite first
I smell of old cloth
My jaw hangs slightly open
Move, and my parts complain
I can chase you standing still
My shadow is longer than my frame
I turn my head in place
I turn my whole face to you
You are standing in my corridor
I lean down to see your face

lines.zh: 我低头，牙正好到你脖子
lines.en: I lower my head and my teeth reach your neck
I open my mouth and make no sound
I count how many places I could bite
I tilt my head slowly
I fix on the light in your hand

lines.zh: 你退到墙边了，我看得见。
lines.en: You've backed to the wall. I can see.
I lean forward a little
I know that fear

lines.zh: 你看我的时候在算什么
lines.en: What are you weighing as you look
There is no saliva in my teeth
I wait to see if you run
I tilt my head and take a step back
Parts rattle loose inside me
I raise a hand to a seam
My motion stutters once
I straighten my head again
I feel no pain, only damage
My pace has slowed
Do not think this ends it
I am an animatronic, I do not eat
You hold food up to me
There is no tongue in my mouth

lines.zh: 我看不见食物，只看见你
lines.en: I see no food, only you
Away with it, I want something else
Put the bread away
I cannot even chew
You are feeding the wrong thing
You hit me and bounce off
My weight is heavier than iron
I do not move when struck
My casing gives a dull knock
You are not strong enough to shift me
I do not even turn my head
You hear the plating
That was only a knock
I look down at your jarred hand
I was built, not born

lines.zh: 这里的玩偶各有各的位置
lines.en: Each animatronic has its place
I have none of my own to seek
That is not mine to ask
I know only corridors and doors
My body is iron and cloth

lines.zh: 你把玩笑开到我头上了
lines.en: You are joking with the wrong thing
I will not answer that
Standing is enough for me
Do not speak of it in front of me

lines.zh: 我拾起地上的一颗螺丝
lines.en: I pick up a screw from the floor
I screw it back into a joint
I pick up a scrap of cloth
I tuck it into my own seam
I pick it up and look
My fingers are too thick
I crush it out of shape
This is not one of my parts

lines.zh: 我这副牙，是给夜里准备的。
lines.en: These teeth were made for the night.
I keep it, it may be useful
Try striking me once
My head snaps straight
I have picked my line
You stand too far from the door
I raise both claws
My jaw has opened
I lock onto your position
I will not count this one out
Did you just touch me
My eyes brighten a notch
I start from the far end
Your shadow reaches my feet
I decide to deal with you first
I come on, step by step
I hear your steps change
You are at the end of the corridor
I do not run, I only walk
My steps have not stopped
Hiding in a room will not help
I heard what you knocked over
I know every door
Your light does not show me
I stay one step behind
Look back, I am there
I tilt my head the other way
You still have some ground to run
I am measuring your speed
The floorboards will tell on you
I am in no hurry to catch you

lines.zh: 我的影子已经把门堵了
lines.en: My shadow has blocked the door
Run all you like, you are inside
I hear you panting
I wait for your strength to run out
My claws sink into your shoulder
One swipe opens your clothes

lines.zh: 我的牙合在你的手臂上
lines.en: My teeth close on your arm
There was no restraint in that
I raise my hand and bring it down
My jaw clamps down hard
You are thrown into the door
I step in and add another

lines.zh: 铁皮手指在你身上收拢
lines.en: My plated fingers close on you
That one carries my whole weight
I bite down harder
You do not have much blood to lose
I hold you down
The corridor lights go out first
I rise out of the dark
My joints click into place
My teeth show through the door gap
The floor complains under me
I stand taller than the doorway
The curtain behind you moves
I come around the corner, head tilted
A smell of iron enters the air
My jaw hangs open
My hand reaches the door's top frame
It starts in this room
I step over the threshold
The light flickers once and dies

lines.zh: 你听见的第二个声音是我
lines.en: The second sound you hear is me

lines.zh: 我站在你进来的那扇门
lines.en: I stand at the door you came through

lines.zh: 火把我的布面烤得发脆
lines.en: Fire makes my cloth brittle
Half of me scatters on landing

lines.zh: 水灌进我的壳，我不再发声
lines.en: Water fills my casing and I go silent
The blast strips off my casing

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在我的关节里
lines.en: An arrow jams my joint
Magic makes my circuits stutter

lines.zh: 我不用吃东西，但零件在锈
lines.en: I do not eat, but my parts corrode
Lightning passes through my casing
My parts scatter as I fall
